content: We Work Remotely: Remote jobs in design, programming, marketing and more https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs.rss We Work Remotely: Remote jobs in design, programming, marketing and more en-US 60 PlanetScale: Developer Educator Anywhere in the World Sales and Marketing Full-Time <p> <strong>Headquarters:</strong> San Francisco and/or US Remote </p> <p>PlanetScale is growing rapidly and reinventing the database space. Our database platform offers developers the fastest and most reliable Postgres and Vitess+MySQL databases, enabling businesses to efficiently handle data and workloads of all scales.&nbsp;</p> <p>We also take DX seriously. Our platform enables developers with deep performance insights, AI integration, powerful cluster management, and schema migration tooling.</p> <p>Our customers trust us with what is often their most precious digital asset: their data. The stakes couldn't be higher. We're looking for a Developer Educator who is excited about bringing database education to new heights, creating unique and engaging content, helping customers, and building the PlanetScale engineering community at conferences, events, and online.</p> <h2>The job</h2> <ul> <li>Create technical content to help customers and engineers at-large learn how Postgres, MySQL, Vitess, Neki, and the PlanetScale ecosystem works</li> <li>Speak at conferences and events, representing PlanetScale in the database and engineering community</li> <li>Create and refine product documentation</li> <li>Host livestreams and webinars to engage with and educate our community</li> <li>Your role may contain between 20-50% travel to connect with developers at events worldwide</li> </ul> <h2>The ideal candidate</h2> <ul> <li>Teaches complex technical concepts in accessible ways</li> <li>Loves learning about and explaining full-stack application development, databases, and compute infrastructure</li> <li>Is a natural communicator who can adapt your message for different audiences</li> <li>Thrives in community settings and enjoy building relationships with developers</li> <li>Has excellent writing skills and can produce content that engineers actually want to read</li> <li>Is self-motivated and can manage multiple projects independently</li> <li>Enjoys experimenting with new ideas to further the education and marketing mission on PlanetScale</li> </ul> <h2>What you will need</h2> <ul> <li>2+ years of experience in engineering, solution architecture, technical education, or developer relations</li> <li>Strong understanding of relational databases (Postgres or MySQL)</li> <li>Proven ability to create technical content (samples of blog posts, tutorials, documentation, or speaking engagements)</li> <li>Experience speaking at conferences or hosting technical presentations and events</li> <li>Willingness to travel between 20-50% of the time</li> </ul> <h2>What else will help you be successful</h2> <ul> <li>Experience with Vitess or other distributed database technologies</li> <li>Knowledge of distributed systems and database scaling challenges</li> <li>Previous experience at a database or infrastructure company</li> </ul> <h2>Why PlanetScale</h2> <p>We're redefining how high-growth companies manage data at scale. We work with some of the most exciting brands in gaming, consumer tech, and B2B SaaS. As a Developer Educator, you'll be at the core of educating our customers to effectively use the platform that powers world-class apps used by hundreds of millions of users worldwide. PlanetScale’s hiring philosophy is centered around building small teams of p99 individuals.</p> <p>At PlanetScale we believe in supporting people to do their best work. We strive to build an environment where people feel that they are respected and valued, whether they are a candidate or an employee.</p> <h2>Total Compensation and Pay Transparency</h2> <p>An employee's total compensation consists of base salary + variable comp where appropriate + benefits + equity. A member of our Talent Acquisition team will be happy to answer any further questions when we engage with you to begin the interview process.</p> <p>Base salary range: $130,000 - $200,000 USD</p> <p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/planetscale-developer-educator">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/planetscale-developer-educator</a></p> Wed, 19 Aug 2026 07:30:41 +0000 Fri, 18 Sep 2026 07:30:41 +0000 https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/planetscale-developer-educator https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/planetscale-developer-educator Postscript: Director, Email Deliverability Anywhere in the World Full-Stack Programming Full-Time <p> <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote </p> <div class="content-intro"><p>Postscript is the AI messaging platform trusted by 20,000+ Shopify brands — including Brooklinen, Ruggable, True Classic, and Dr. Squatch.&nbsp;</p> <p>With a mission to make SMS your number one revenue driving channel, we built the best-in-class SMS marketing platform and launched revenue-driving AI features not available on any other platform. And we're just getting started.&nbsp;</p> <p>Backed by Greylock and Y Combinator, fully remote since 2018.</p></div><h1>Director, Email Deliverability</h1> <p>Postscript is the AI messaging platform trusted by 20,000+ Shopify brands — including Brooklinen, Ruggable, True Classic, and Dr. Squatch.</p> <p>We built the best-in-class SMS marketing platform and the revenue-driving AI features no other platform offers — and now we're bringing that same obsession to email. As we expand into a true multi-channel platform for high-growth DTC brands, getting every message to the inbox is mission-critical.</p> <p>Backed by Greylock and Y Combinator, fully remote since 2018.</p> <h2><strong>Job Description</strong></h2> <p>As the <strong>Director, Email Deliverability</strong> at Postscript, you'll own the strategy, infrastructure, and sender reputation that get our customers' email to the primary inbox. This is a foundational, hands-on leadership role: you'll build Postscript's email deliverability function from the ground up — IP and domain architecture, authentication standards, reputation monitoring, and mailbox-provider relationships — while serving as the trusted deliverability advisor our brands rely on as they migrate and scale their email programs on Postscript.</p> <p>You'll partner closely with Product and Engineering to shape the deliverability tooling and infrastructure our platform is built on, and with Customer Success and Support to keep our customers' programs healthy. You'll set the standard for how 20,000+ brands reach the inbox — and as the function grows, you'll build and lead the team behind it.</p> <p><strong>This is a fully remote position and can be based in the US or Canada.</strong></p> <h2><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></h2> <p><strong>Deliverability Strategy &amp; Sender Reputation</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own Postscript's end-to-end email deliverability strategy — IP pool architecture, domain strategy, and shared vs. dedicated sending models.</li> <li>Design and manage IP and domain warming programs that get new senders to volume quickly and safely.</li> <
